lines.t: ‎In the garden of my sorrow I still weep alone
‎No gentle hands to dry the tears that stain this stone
‎I gave it all — the blood, the thorns, the final breath
‎Yet empty arms reach out to me and turn away instead
‎[Pre-Chorus]
‎My own have closed their hearts, they wear my name in vain
‎They chase their ways and call it faith, but leave me in the rain
‎[Chorus]
‎Oh beloved… who will mourn with me tonight?
‎Who will stop and feel the weight of love’s unfinished fight?
‎You stepped inside the gate, yet still you hold the door
‎Refusing to be broken, leaning on what came before
‎What more can I give, my child? What more can I say?
‎Come let the old skin fall away… come let me have my way
‎[Verse 2]
‎You taste my words like summer fruit and quickly walk on by
‎You borrow strength from other lips but never truly cry
‎Hypocrisy wears holy robes, yet fear still rules the night
‎You push away the reaching hand that longs to make you right
‎[Bridge]
‎How can I heal what will not bend?
‎How can I free what will not end?
‎Lay down the mask, the pride, the show
‎Let every hidden fracture show…
‎And I will meet you there
‎Oh beloved… will you mourn with me tonight?
‎Will you kiss these open wounds and step into the light?
‎Shed this dying world like dust beneath your feet
‎Let my love rewrite your name in mercy pure and sweet
‎What more can I give, my child?
‎I’ve already given everything…
‎Come home… come home… and truly live.
‎I’m still waiting… still waiting… for you.
